meta.title: Lottery tax by state (2026)
meta.description: Lottery winnings tax rates and withholding for all 50 states, Washington, D.C., New York City and Yonkers, with the take-home on a $1,000,000 prize. Tax year 2026.
meta.assumptions: take_home_on_1m and state_local_tax_on_1m: a $1,000,000 prize taken as a lump sum by a single filer with no other income who lives in the jurisdiction, 2026 federal and state rates, standard deduction. Federal income tax on that prize is $320,000 everywhere.

jurisdictions.notes: State tax plus the average Maryland county income tax
Figures include New York State tax
Surcharge of 16.75% of New York State tax; figures include New York State tax

rules.method: Tax on a prize = tax(other income + prize) - tax(other income), using progressive brackets [start_usd, rate]. Federal taxable income subtracts the standard deduction first; state brackets apply to income without a deduction. Each tax is rounded to whole dollars. Head of household uses the single state brackets.

MD_COUNTY_AVERAGE.note: Simple average of the 24 Maryland county top rates, applied to the whole prize
